headline: Illegal hunting in Peru's protected forests
standfirst: A look at the reality of conservation enforcement in the Amazon.

steps.label: What happened
steps.text: A visitor to Peru's Allpahuayo-Mishana National Reserve was offered a live owl for sale.

steps.label: How we got here
steps.text: The offer occurred in 2005, despite commercial hunting being banned in that protected area.

steps.label: Why it matters
steps.text: The incident highlights the ongoing struggle to protect wildlife within established reserves.

steps.label: What to watch
steps.text: Look for updates on how local authorities manage illegal logging and hunting in the region.

caption:
This is the reality of illegal wildlife trade inside Peru's Allpahuayo-Mishana National Reserve.

Protected areas are meant to keep wildlife safe from commercial activity. This encounter shows that enforcement remains a difficult challenge on the ground.
